stem.text: Which statement relating to the elements in Group 17 and their compounds is correct?

A.text: Bromine will reduce $\text{KI}$ to form iodine.

B.text: Iodide ions react to form a white precipitate when added to silver nitrate solution.

C.text: Bromide ions react to form a white precipitate when added to silver nitrate solution.

D.text: Chlorine reacts with hydrogen to form a colourless gas.
